claim_ceiling: Dense embeddings (center_projected) are NECESSARY and SUFFICIENT for three complementary product views at characterized minimal scales: (1) Citation Heritage View — AUC > 0.75 at 21yr+/137k+ (24yr/158k AUC 0.767-0.770 with 730 pairs); (2) Section Cross-Lingual View — Sachverhalt cross_lang > 0.2, Dispositiv > 0.1 at 1K sample (Erwaegungen FAIL); (3) Linear Hybrid Complement — PASS adversarial gates at 19yr+/122k+ (w=0.3-0.4, JP 0.61-0.67) but BELOW TF-IDF baseline (JP 0.78-0.79). NO single representation dominates all metrics (LangDom, JP, CiteIndep) at any scale. Dense embeddings FAIL jurist gate at ALL scales (JP 0.05-0.43). True OOS JuristPref ceiling ~0.53 < 0.7 factory target. Legal TF-IDF from BGE corpus FAILS (AUC ~0.5). Data blockers: bge_/bger_ mapping, parquet 2024-2026, section extraction 174k. Lane correctly BLOCKED_ON_DEPENDENCIES with continue_recommended=false.
evidence_summary: Verified 8/8 critical findings against source data: (1) Citation heritage dense superiority (AUC 0.77-0.85 > TF-IDF 0.71-0.74) at 21-24yr scales with 100-730 positive pairs; (2) Section cross-lingual hierarchy (Sachverhalt 0.282 > 0.2, Dispositiv 0.150 > 0.1, Erwaegungen 0.094 < 0.1); (3) Linear hybrid optimal weight shifts 19yr w=0.3 → 22yr w=0.3-0.4, PASS gates but below TF-IDF JP; (4) Two-mode tradeoff fundamental (TF-IDF: JP~0.78/LD~0.48, Dense: JP~0.43/LD~0.83, Hybrid: JP~0.67/LD~0.65); (5) Dense JP FAIL all scales (0.05-0.43); (6) True OOS ceiling ~0.53 < 0.7; (7) BGE corpus negative (all AUC ~0.5); (8) V18 hierarchy max purity 0.65 < 0.7. One narrative error: legal-distance.json claims '2021-2023 flagged as failed in progress.json' but progress.json shows them in completed_years with explicit note they EXIST and PASS quality check (only 2024-2026 failed). Test suite 6/7 PASS (1 blocked on /tmp/lex_accepted missing). Characterization complete at max available scale.
